body:
## Fix

F1. Anchor a saved deck's modification timestamp to persisted updatedAt, not createdAt. A backward system clock no longer regresses the deck's modification timestamp.
F2. Add fake-IndexedDB regression: create at Jan 3, save with clock at Jan 2, retain Jan 3 updatedAt.

## Validation

V1. Regression reproduced failure before fix; green after fix.
V2. Worker: 26 deck test files, 224 tests passed; 52 domain-boundary tests passed.
V3. Parent reran repository suite: 21 tests passed. Parent reviewed timestamp helper, save transaction, regression, and scoped diff.
V4. Typecheck: 0 errors, 4 existing Svelte warnings. Changed-file ESLint/Prettier and diff check passed.

## Limits

L1. Full repository/build/browser suites not run locally. No rendered component changes. CI remains separate.
title: fix(decks): preserve modified order across clock rollback
